B2C Community Manager Job at the Tonic Technologies Limited




        
    

        
        The Tonic Technologies Limited is a Nigerian fintech platform where people buy and sell gift cards, create Virtual Dollar Cards, pay local and international bills, shop gadgets on Just Gadgets, and buy eSIMs. We serve users in Nigeria and Ghana. Our community is loud, funny and very online, and we want someone who fits right in. You won't just be posting. You'll be replying, reacting, starting conversations and making people feel like there's a real person behind the brand, because there will be. You'll also work closely with Tonic FC, our grassroots football club, on community content and activations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: B2C Community Manager
     

            
    



Job Location: Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time (Remote)

Job Summary


	We are looking for a B2C Community Manager to be the voice, vibe and hype-person of our community.
	You'll run the day-to-day conversation across X (Twitter), Telegram, Instagram and TikTok, keep the banter going, spot what's trending before everyone else, and turn what the community is saying into real input for our product, support and marketing teams.
	This is a fully remote role, open only to Nigerians currently living in Nigeria.


Responsibilities


	Own day-to-day replies and engagement across X (Twitter), Telegram, Instagram and TikTok.
	Keep conversations and banter alive so the community feels active, not just broadcast to.
	Spot trends, memes and cultural moments early and turn them into timely community content.
	Monitor community sentiment, then route complaints to support and praise to the right teams.
	Plan and run community activations, giveaways and campaigns.
	Work with Tonic FC on football-led community content and activations.
	Turn community feedback and insight into clear input for product, support and marketing.
	Benchmark similar communities and bring back ideas we can use.
	Handle tense or negative conversations with a steady head and protect the brand's reputation.


Requirements
Education:


	A Degree or HND in Mass Communication, Marketing, English, or a related field is welcome but not required. Proven community experience matters more than certificates.


Experience:


	Minimum of 3 years of experience in fintech, in a community, social media or similar role.
	A track record of growing a community from "just posting" to genuinely engaged.
	Experience with football fan communities and high-energy online communities where banter runs deep is a big plus.


Skills:


	Sharp, witty writing with a natural sense of humour.
	Deep understanding of how online communities behave, especially on X, Telegram, Instagram and TikTok.
	Strong instinct for trends, memes and internet culture in Nigeria.
	Calm, sound judgement when comments get spicy.
	Ability to read sentiment and summarise community insight clearly for other teams.
	Good organisation for running campaigns, giveaways and activations end to end.


Other Requirements: 


	Must be Nigerian.
	Must have at least 3 years of community managementexperience. Fintech Industry is a plus.
	Must be chronically online and fluent in internet culture.
	Must be comfortable working remotely and independently.
	Please include your LinkedIn profile and an up-to-date CV. Links to communities or accounts you've managed will strengthen your application.


Note: If you can read a comment section and instantly know the mood, write a reply that gets people laughing, and stay calm when things get heated, we'd like to meet you.

Senior Purchaser Job at Bourbon Interoil Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        Bourbon Interoil Nigeria Limited, as leading international player in marine services, offers to the most demanding oil & gas clients worldwide a full line of innovative, safe, high performance and new generation vessels and an expanded offer of offshore oil & gas services.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Senior Purchaser

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full-time

About the Job
     

            
    




	The role is responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and ensuring the timely delivery of goods and services required to support the organisation’s operations, including vessel and RC requirements.
	The position identifies the best available solutions, negotiates favourable prices and product specifications, creates and manages purchase orders, and follows up with suppliers to ensure timely delivery.
	The role also maintains accurate and up-to-date purchase order information, builds and manages effective relationships with local suppliers on technical and commercial matters, and supports the development and maintenance of the supplier database and tender process to ensure value for money, efficiency, and continuity of supply.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:
Job Position: Quality Control Lead

Job Location: Lagos

	Address complaints and feedback related to product quality, and implement corrective actions.
	Collaborate with production, supply chain, and R&D teams to ensure customer requirements and expectations are met.


Qualifications


	HND / BSc Degree in Food Science, Hospitality Management, Catering, or a related field with 2–4 years of experience in kitchen operations, food production, or quality control within a food service environment.
	Knowledge of food safety regulations and quality assurance practices is an advantage.
	Strong leadership, planning, and reporting skills.
	Knowledge of food safety and hygiene standards.
